result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within a priority. The full `mvn -q -o test` run passed, but I didn't add a test for the new order, so the T-1 to T-5 example isn't checked.

The change is in `DataStore.listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. Its `ORDER BY` now uses the same priority ordering as `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep`, with `opened_date` and `id` as tie-breakers. I also updated the Javadoc to match. Closed tickets and other regions' tickets are filtered out as before.

I didn't commit anything.
